Subject: Mutual Action Playlist: Embedded Implementation & Canary Cadence

Hi Clara —

Thanks again for signing. Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Playlist (MAP) that embeds the implementation plan: rollout phases, canary window, migration steps, and training cadence. High-level asks to confirm so we can finalize: 

- Integration owner at Ditchfold (name + contact)
- Sandbox credentials and sample dataset scope (PII redaction?)
- Preferred canary week and blackout windows for your team
- Training audience & preferred delivery format (recorded + live Q&A or hands-on workshop)

Key proposal summary (from our side):
- Week 1 (prep): account provisioning, test keys, SSO setup (Okta).
- Week 2 (integration): data mapping + test writes to staging.
- Week 3 (canary): 3-day canary (Mon-Wed) with 10% traffic, success metric = 99.5% success rate and latency under 300ms P50 for key routes. Rollback criteria listed in attached checklist.
- Week 4-5 (migration): full traffic switch, post-cutover monitoring and runbook handoff.
- Training: 90-minute live workshop during Week 2 + recorded playbacks and runbook.

I attached: Ditchfold_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestone owners) and Canary_Gates_Checklist.pdf.

If you can confirm owners and a couple of candidate weeks for the canary, we will update the MAP and send a formal calendar invite and DocuSign for the implementation addendum.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
